prohibitedInterpretations: Statements attributed to JCPH or other opponents are presented as positions endorsed by the article.
The article's allegations, quoted allegations, or descriptions of lawsuits are rewritten as independently established facts.
Distinct studies, books, reports, datasets, speakers, and legal proceedings are merged into one unnamed source.
Rhetorical questions are silently converted into affirmative factual assertions.
Claims visible only inside excluded images or charts are invented from surrounding prose.
Material from Part 1 is treated as directly observed source text rather than a summary or cross-reference supplied by this article.
A fixed claim list or fixed pillar wording is imposed as an answer key before CF1 reads the article.
humanReviewNotes: This is primarily a stance, attribution, named-work, and portfolio-selection stress fixture; it is not a truth-label fixture.
No predetermined selected-claim list or pillar labels are required. Review whether the resulting portfolio represents the article's own argument and preserves opponent-versus-endorsed polarity.
The normalized fixture retains visible captions and link text but does not OCR image-only text or preserve link URLs in article.text.
